caption:
Koko walks up steep hills on her way to work in the CBD, and lately the back of her heel pulls on every climb.

Walking uphill asks more of your calves and Achilles than flat ground. A sudden jump in hills, or rushing up in big strides, can let that load build up.

Hybi's tip: build calf strength with slow heel raises, take shorter steps uphill, and add hilly routes gradually. Supportive shoes can help too.

Trouble rising onto your toes, swelling above the heel, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
